name: @spriteflow/segment
description: Pure TypeScript character segmentation core: bit masks, part assets, pixel-invariant pixel extraction, L1 locate parsing, SAM session orchestration. Root entry is DOM-free (ES2022 + TypedArray only, Node testable); ./browser hosts the fetch LLM transport, the approved SAM model registry and the onnxruntime-web backend.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
